patches_added.name: Chat preview buttons
patches_added.description: Adds Open chat and Close preview to the menu under a chat you press and hold, so the preview opens fully or goes away with one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_added.name: Free proxies
patches_added.description: Downloads a public list of MTProto proxies, times them and keeps the 10 fastest in Telegram's proxy list, refreshed every 6 hours. Telegram connects through them unless you use a proxy of your own. The phone number screen also always has the proxy button, so you can add one before you sign in, and Proxy order puts Telegram's proxy list in an order of your own, with pinned proxies on top. Finding proxies starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_added.name: Keep captions with their photos
patches_added.description: When you remove or reorder photos that each have a caption in the attach menu, every caption stays with its own photo instead of moving to the new first photo. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_added.name: Lyrics and song dates
patches_added.description: Adds Lyrics to the music player's menu, found on lrclib.net and scrolling along with the song, and shows when you added each song to your profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: My messages
patches_added.description: Adds My messages to a group's menu at the top, which searches the group for the messages you sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_added.name: Never send an uncropped photo
patches_added.description: When Telegram can't finish cropping a photo, keeps the editor open and asks you to try again instead of sending the photo uncropped. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_added.name: Proxy in the chat list menu
patches_added.description: Keeps Proxy in the chat list's menu, which Telegram only shows while a proxy is on or where Telegram is blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_added.name: Text direction
patches_added.description: Adds Right to left, Left to right and Control character to the text menu of the message box, so you can set which way a line reads or add an invisible Unicode mark. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.
